candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement that adds msg.value to the caller's balance, so deposits no longer update balances.
Replace the cumulative balance update with an assignment, so each deposit overwrites rather than accumulates the caller's balance.
Replace the balance increment with a decrement of msg.value, changing deposits to subtract from the caller's balance instead of adding.
Remove the initialization guard so SetMinSum can change MinSum even after the contract is initialized.
Invert the guard condition so SetMinSum only works when the contract is already initialized.
Remove the assignment so SetMinSum no longer changes MinSum.
Change the assignment to an accumulation so SetMinSum adds the value to MinSum instead of replacing it.
Remove the guard so SetMinSum can still modify MinSum after the contract is initialized.
Replace the assignment to MinSum with a constant so _val is ignored.
Delete the assignment 'Log = LogFile(_log);' so SetLogFile never changes Log, leaving the default address observable.
Replace 'Log = LogFile(_log);' with 'Log = LogFile(msg.sender);' so Log is set to the caller's address instead of the argument.
Invert the guard to 'if(!intitalized)revert();' so SetLogFile reverts before initialization and never sets Log afterwards.
Delete the line that credits msg.value to the caller's balance so deposits no longer increase balances.
Replace the credited amount msg.value with 1 wei so deposits always credit exactly 1 instead of the sent value.
Credit the contract's own address instead of the depositor, so the caller's balance no longer increases on deposit.
Delete the Log.AddMessage call so deposits are no longer recorded in the log contract.
